privacy.heading: Privacy & Security
privacy.autoRotationDescription: How often your transport identity changes. Applied on next app restart.
privacy.autoRotationDescriptionLtc: How often your transport identity changes. Applied on next app restart. Your long-term code is not reachable after a rotation right now, so each change stops the copies you already shared from working.
privacy.typingIndicatorsDescription: Contacts see when you are typing. Disable for more privacy.
privacy.readReceiptsDescription: Contacts see when you have read their messages. Off by default for privacy.
privacy.blockedDescription: People you block cannot connect to you or send you messages.
privacy.clearHistoryCardDescription: Delete chat history for a specific contact or all of them.
privacy.clearTargetDescription: Messages are permanently removed from this device.
privacy.deleteAllDataDescription: Wipes contacts, messages, keys, and everything from this device. Your identity is lost unless you have an exported backup.
privacy.rotatePeerIdMessage: A new transport identity will be generated and broadcast to your contacts.
privacy.rotatePeerIdDetail: Only do this if you suspect your current peer ID is compromised, or you want to reset how the network finds you. Existing conversations are preserved.
privacy.rotatePeerIdDetailLtc: Only do this if you suspect your current peer ID is compromised, or you want to reset how the network finds you. Existing conversations are preserved, but every copy of your long-term code file stops working until you share a fresh one.
privacy.clearHistoryDialogMessage: All messages with {target} will be deleted from this device.
privacy.clearHistoryDialogDetail: This cannot be undone. Copies on the other side are not affected.
privacy.deleteAllDialog1Message: This wipes all contacts, messages, identity keys, and cached backups.
privacy.deleteAllDialog1Detail: Your identity is gone unless you have exported a backup. This cannot be undone.
privacy.deleteAllDialog2Message: Once deleted, nothing can be recovered. Export a backup first if anything should be kept. This will close the app to reset it. Please open it again.
privacy.infoRestartRequired: Saved. Will take effect after restart.
privacy.appLockBiometricDescription: Unlock Kursal with Face ID, Touch ID, or your device passcode each time it opens.

securityCode.heading: Security Code Verification
securityCode.explanation: Read this code out loud with your contact over a separate channel. If the codes match, tap Confirm.

autostart.title: Open Kursal on start-up?
autostart.body: You're only reachable while the app runs. Let me start Kursal with your system, and messages arrive instantly instead of waiting for offline delivery. Change it anytime in **Settings → Advanced**.

fileOffer.title: Your file hasn't left yet
fileOffer.body: You sent a file *offer*, not the file itself. When your contact accepts it, it will initiate the transfer. Don't delete your file yet!

offlineMessages.title: Friend offline? No worries
offlineMessages.body: They're unreachable right now, so your message is queued. Either they reconnect and the message directly delivers, or they receive your offline-delivered message.

verifyContact.title: Quick security check?
verifyContact.body: You two are chatting a lot! To be sure nobody slipped between you during first contact, compare your **security code** together. Over a call or in person. Match means the encryption is airtight.
